name: What are the electrical requirements for under-cabinet lighting?

mainEntity.name: What are the electrical requirements for under-cabinet lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most under-cabinet lighting systems operate on standard household voltage (120V) or low voltage (12V/24V) with a transformer. Hardwired installations require a dedicated circuit or connection to an existing one, ideally controlled by a switch. Before installation, you may need to confirm if your existing outlets or wiring can support the new load, or if new wiring is necessary. This preparation ensures safety and optimal functionality, and Hometelligent Inc. can help assess these needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Systems use 120V or low voltage; hardwired options need an appropriate circuit. Assess existing wiring before installation.
